sources.title: ID Document Liveness Detection SDK - KBY-AI
sources.snippet: The ID Document Liveness Detection SDK offers a robust document liveness solution that detects presentation attacks automatically and efficiently. It evaluates whether a submitted image represents a genuine, unaltered document physically presented to the capturing device. The SDK supports a wide range of government-issued identity documents globally, including ID cards, passports, and driver ...
